statement:
∀ U : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ → ℝ, (∀ z, 0 ≤ U z) → Summable U →
 (∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => U (p.1, p.2, k-p.1-p.2))) ∧
 Summable (fun k : ℤ => ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, U (p.1,p.2,k-p.1-p.2)) ∧
 (∑' k : ℤ, ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, U (p.1,p.2,k-p.1-p.2)) = ∑' z, U z
proof:
intro U hU hs
let E : (ℤ × (ℤ × ℤ)) ≃ (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
 { toFun := fun p => (p.2.1,p.2.2,p.1-p.2.1-p.2.2)
   invFun := fun z => (z.1+z.2.1+z.2.2,z.1,z.2.1)
   left_inv := by intro p; rcases p with ⟨k,a,b⟩; dsimp; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; trace_state; omega
   right_inv := by intro z; rcases z with ⟨a,b,c⟩; dsimp; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; trace_state; omega }
have hs' : Summable (fun p => U (E p)) := E.summable_iff.mpr hs
have hh := (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p => hU (E p))).mp hs'
refine ⟨hh.1, hh.2, ?_⟩
exact (hs'.tsum_prod' hh.1).symm.trans (E.tsum_eq U)
